_meta.notes: Defines all named storage units in B144. Each storage_unit slug is referenced by locations.tsv, consumables.tsv, and chemicals.tsv. Sublocations are named shelves, drawers, or sections within the unit.

storage_units.name: Enzyme Freezer (-20°C)
storage_units.notes: Student-accessible benchtop -20°C freezer. Working tubes of enzymes, buffers, and sample storage.

storage_units.name: Projects Freezer (-20°C)
storage_units.notes: Main -20°C freezer. Project-specific samples, plasmids, and backup stocks. Requires training, for supervisors only.

storage_units.name: -80°C Freezer
storage_units.notes: Ultra-low -80°C countertop freezer. Long-term storage of competent cells and glycerol stocks. Requires training, for supervisors only.

storage_units.name: Main Fridge (4°C)
storage_units.notes: 4°C refrigerator. Sterile petri dishes, DMEM, agarose gels, and anything cold but not cellular.

storage_units.name: Culture Fridge (4°C)
storage_units.notes: 4°C mini-fridge. Active bacterial cultures and petri dishes.

storage_units.name: Flammable Cabinet
storage_units.notes: Built-in flammable storage cabinet below the chemical hood on the south wall. Two shelves plus an organic acids subdivider bin. Training required, supervisors only.

storage_units.name: Chemical Cabinet
storage_units.notes: Built-in corrosives cabinet below the chemical hood, to the left of the flammable cabinet. Subdivided into bases and inorganic acids sections. Training required, supervisors only.

storage_units.name: North Wall Cabinet
storage_units.notes: Under-counter closed cabinet on the north wall (right-lower zone), to the left of the sink. Two shelves. Non-hazardous chemicals from the institutional inventory are stored here.

storage_units.name: North Wall Open Shelves
storage_units.notes: Open shelves above the counter on the north wall. Non-hazardous supplies: LB agar, gelatin, buffer reagents, etc. Not tracked in the institutional chemical inventory.

storage_units.name: Under-Sink Storage
storage_units.notes: Storage area under the sink on the north wall. Bleach and cleaning supplies.
